data.name: Needle in a Haystack
data.detailed_description:
It sounds simple: somewhere inside this enormous haystack, there is a single needle.

Start searching with your bare hands, remove the hay piece by piece, and gradually unlock new tools that make the job faster and more satisfying. Use rakes, pitchforks, wheelbarrows, blowers, and other equipment to move large amounts of hay, organize your search area, and get closer to the needle.

Search alone for a peaceful and relaxing experience, or invite your friends and turn an impossible task into cooperative chaos.

Sell or recycle the hay you collect, earn money, improve your equipment, and create a more efficient search strategy. Just remember: the needle could be anywhere.
